card.name: Lord Skitter's Butcher
card.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, choose one —
• Create a 1/1 black Rat creature token with "This token can't block."
• You may sacrifice another creature. If you do, scry 2, then draw a card.
• Creatures you control gain menace until end of turn.

abilities.note: Modal ETB (choose one): only the Rat-token mode is modelled -- summing all three modes would over-count. The 'token can't block' rider is dropped.
